scripts.verify:logic: esbuild scripts/verify.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/verify.cjs --log-level=error && node /tmp/verify.cjs; status=$?; rm -f /tmp/verify.cjs; exit $status
scripts.verify:dom: esbuild scripts/dom-smoke.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.smoke.cjs --jsx=automatic --log-level=error --loader:.css=empty --external:jsdom --external:react --external:react-dom --external:scheduler && node .smoke.cjs; status=$?; rm -f .smoke.cjs; exit $status
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:logic && npm run verify:dom && npm run build
